name: HITEAM
description_en:
HITEAM is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Discussion Boards, Chat (Messaging), Task Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $31.0. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: exchange messages within the supported workspace; create, assign and track units of work. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
